description:
TerraTrikes Built for Two
Color: Sparkle Copper
TerraTrike tandems are a safe and easy way to enjoy riding with another person. Each of our tandems is designed to meet the needs of different riding styles, and are well suited to accommodate nearly any pair of riders. And now you can get a little electric assistance whenever you need it!
The Tandem Pro Charge includes the Promovec 50750-BL Motor. This motor is a powerful drive unit that provides acceleration up to 20mph. With this system riders experience the latest in drive technology, including a wide range of built-in power assistance levels.
Control your experience and share your rides with the Connect + app compatible controller, giving riders access to a variety of riding modes.
Included in each kit is:

Promovec 50750-BL 250W Motor built into 20" rear ATC wheel
DT2 36V-374Wh Battery
D700 Graphic Slim Display (Vertical Handlebar kit only)
5 Levels of Pedal Assist
Compact Battery Charger

For the ultimate in partnered riding, you cannot beat the performance and quality of the Tandem Pro. The Tandem Pro features a Chro-moly steel frame, breathable Comfort Mesh seats, and high-end components throughout. It comes equipped with an Independent Pedaling System (IPS), meaning one rider can coast while the other rider is pedaling.

The high-performance construction and components of this tandem trike make full use of the power of two riders. The Tandem Pro is simply the best… and is sure to turn heads as you cruise by! The Tandem Pro is proudly made in the United States of America.

**The Tandem Pro Charge now comes standard with a full fender set (20" front and rear).
